αἰνῆς: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ὀϊζύος
αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
αἴσυλα: αἴσυλος — presumptuous, reckless, wicked (paired with look-alike αἴσιμος); neut. acc. pl., object of ῥέζοι: ’wicked things’
γλαφυρῇσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
γοόωσα: γοάω — wail, sob, lament; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶσα)
γούνασι: γόνυ — knee; dat. pl., epic γούνασι (= Attic γόνασι)
γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
δέδετο: δέω — bind; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέδετο): ’was bound’ · also plpf. mid. 3 sg. + acc., with tmesis: ’had bound on (himself)’ (περὶ … κνημῖδας … δέδετο)
δεσμὸς: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. nom. sg.
δεσμῷ: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. sg.
διομήδεος: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg.
δῆσαν: δέω — bind, bandage; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδησαν)
εἶδαρ: εἶδαρ — food, fare; neut. acc. sg., object of ἔδουσιν
εἶκε: εἴκω — yield, give way (+ gen. of what one yields from); pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give way!’
κάββαλεν: καταβάλλω — throw down, let drop; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, κατά assimilated (κὰβ βάλε = κατέβαλε), ν-movable
καλέονται: καλέω — call, name; pres. 3 pl. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦνται)
καλλίτριχας: καλλίθριξ — fair-maned, fair-haired (καλός + θρίξ); masc./fem. acc. pl.
καλόν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun (καλόν τε μέγαν τε ’fine and tall’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (of a gift: τιμῆεν, μάλα καλόν ’precious, very fine’)
κοιρανέουσιν: κοιρανέω — be lord or ruler over, hold sway; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a husband or wife); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun: κουρίδιον δῶμα ’the wedded home’
κρατερώνυχας: κρατερώνυξ — strong-hoofed; masc. acc. pl. (of mules)
μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat.: ’should fight against’
μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv. · also ’without cause’, beside an infinitive of a wrongful act (μαψιδίως ψεύδεσθαι ’to lie without cause’)
μῆνας: μείς (Ionic μήν) — month; masc. acc. pl.
νεκύεσσι: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’ · also οἷός τε + inf., ’able to, fit to’ (οἷός τε … κήδεσθαι ’such as to care for, able to care for’)
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
πετέσθην: πέτομαι — fly; impf. dual 3rd pers., unaugmented: ’the two flew’
ποθέουσα: ποθέω — long for, miss (+ acc. or gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ποθοῦσα)
πρυμνὸν: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the end or base; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὦμον: ’at its base’
πύθηαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, find out; aor. subj. 2 sg., uncontracted ending (= Attic πύθῃ)
πῖπτε: πίπτω — fall; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιπτε)
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’
τειρόμενον: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’worn down’
τιθέντες: τίθημι — put, place; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
τρισκαίδεκα: τρεισκαίδεκα — thirteen; numeral, indeclinable (τρεῖς + καὶ + δέκα)
φίλοιο: φίλος — dear; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
φίλτατός: φίλος — dear; superl. φίλτατος, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’dearest’
φιλομμειδὴς: φιλομμειδής — smile-loving (φιλο- + μειδάω ’smile’); fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Aphrodite
χάριτες: χάρις — grace, charm; pl. Χάριτες ’the Graces’, attendants of Aphrodite; fem. nom. pl.
χαλέπ: χαλεπός — hard, grievous; neut. acc. pl., elided (χαλέπ’ = χαλεπά): ’grievous’ (pains)
χαλεπὸς: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. sg.
χαλκέῳ: χάλκεος — of bronze; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκῷ)
χερσί: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl. (without movable ν)
ἀγκὰς: ἀγκάς — in the arms, in an embrace; adv.
ἀλωῆος: Ἀλωεύς — Aloeus; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἀμφιτρύωνος: Ἀμφιτρύων — Amphitryon, husband of Alcmene; masc. gen. sg.: ’of Amphitryon’
ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, stir (to something); aor. 3 sg., the gnomic aorist of a general truth · also simple aorist ’let go, released’, of sleep releasing a sleeper (τὴν δὲ γλυκὺς ὕπνος ἀνῆκε ’sweet sleep released her’)
ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.
ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); masc./fem. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄρτια: ἄρτιος — fitting, suitable; neut. acc. pl.: ’fitting things’
ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’ · also, same spelling, fut. inf. (Attic ἐλᾶν): ’to be going to drive’, told apart only by context
ἐλαυνέμεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, row; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐλαύνειν)
ἐπιβὰς: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on, alight; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.; usually + gen., but here + acc. (Πιερίην), an epic extension meaning ’reach, arrive at’: ’having stepped upon, alighting’ · also + gen., the usual construction (Κίρκης ἐπιβὰς … εὐνῆς ’mounting Circe’s bed’)
ἑτέρωθι: ἑτέρωθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv.
ἑῆς: ἑός, ἑή, ἑόν — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); fem. gen. sg.; not the relative
ἔβαινε: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 sg.: ’was stepping’
ἔβαινεν: βαίνω — step, go; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was going, went’
ἔρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’did, performed’
ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, set up, station; aor. 3 sg. transitive: ’set (it) up’
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
ἰάχουσα: ἰάχω — cry out, shriek; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’crying out’
ἰφθίμη: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with βασίλεια
ὀδύνῃσι: ὀδύνη — pain, pang; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ὀδύναις)
ὀδύνῃσιν: ὀδύνη — pain, grief; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
ὀπάζων: ὀπάζω — make follow, grant, heap on; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ὑπέρθυμος: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, of overflowing spirit (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. nom. sg.
ὕπερ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + gen., accent thrown back when it stands after its noun (anastrophe): ’above’
ὠκὺν: ὠκύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὀϊστόν
ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; also ’perform a sacrifice’; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
